token = apis.spotify.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password='CSt&iY1')['access_token']

# Fetch all artist candidates named 'Zoey James'
api = apis.spotify
api_results = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = api.search_artists(query='Zoey James', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, access_token=token)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else None)
    if not resp:
        break
    api_results.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

print('total_artists', len(api_results))
# filter exact name match
candidates = [a for a in api_results if a.get('name','').strip().lower() == 'zoey james']
print('exact_name_candidates', len(candidates))
print('candidate_ids', [(a['artist_id'], a['name'], a.get('follower_count')) for a in candidates])

arguments.code:
token = apis.spotify.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password='CSt&iY1')['access_token']
print('logged_in')
api = apis.spotify
artist_id = 9
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
songs = []
while True:
    resp = api.search_songs(artist_id=artist_id, sort_by='+play_count', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', 0 if not resp else len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    songs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('total_songs', len(songs))
# show a few smallest by play_count
songs_sorted = sorted(songs, key=lambda s: (s.get('play_count', None), s.get('song_id', None)))
min_play = songs_sorted[0]['play_count'] if songs_sorted else None
min_candidates = [s for s in songs_sorted if s.get('play_count', None) == min_play]
print('min_play_count', min_play)
print('num_min_candidates', len(min_candidates))
print('min_candidates_titles', [c['title'] for c in min_candidates[:10]])
# deterministic pick: smallest song_id among min candidates
pick = min(min_candidates, key=lambda s: s.get('song_id', 0)) if min_candidates else None
print('picked', pick['title'], pick['song_id']) if pick else None
